subject: Problems with detection history including cam effort

messages.author: 71012b8732697ac2
messages.subject: Problems with detection history including cam effort
parts:
Dear Jürgen

I have been using CamtrapR package for preparing my data (camera trap records) for occupancy models and Null models.

In my field work I had different camera effort during the sampling period and  that´s why I want to includ this effort in the detection history, but when I ran the code the resulting matrix contain "0","1", and "NAs",and I don´t want the "NAs" 

Following the instructions on the package PDF, my detection History resulting matrix shouldn´t have "NAs"

I´m not sure if I am running correctly the code or maybe I have an error that couldn´t find.

Please find attached the script I am using as well as the camera info table and a subset of the data

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Problems with detection history including cam effort
parts:
Hi, 
it is normal for the detection matrix to have NAs along with 0s and 1s. It depends a little on the setting you choose in detectionHistory, but generally speaking occasions that were not sampled (or incomplete occasions) result in NAs. This is perfectly normal and expected. 

See here for some more details:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/vignettes/DataExtraction.html#handling-of-incomplete-occasions

I will rephrase and elaborate a little more in the vignette to clarify.

Does this answer your question? I did not run the code, but it looks ok.

Jürgen
